newsitem.title: USA: Chyron sets one for three reverse split.
newsitem.headline: Chyron sets one for three reverse split.

text.p: Chyron Corp said on Monday it filed a proxy statement with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission for a special meeting of shareholders to authorize a one-for-three reverse stock split.
The company also said it filed a registration statement with the SEC for a proposed 7.65 million share, post-split, secondary offering.

The company said it would offer 5.25 million shares and certain selling shareholders would offer 2.4 million shares. Oppenheimer & Co Inc, Volpe, Welty & Co and Southcoast Capital Corp were managing underwriters.
The board expected to do a reverse stock split only if the company went ahead with the secondary offering, Chyron said.
If shareholders approved the split, the board had until March 14 to put it into place, the company said.
